steps.message:
# Several things look wrong in a race recording

I recorded a short race (`recording.mp4`) and several things in it don't look the way they
normally do in this game.

Some of what a vehicle carries, or has carried, is drawn or hidden wrongly compared with that
vehicle (it can show through something that covers the vehicle, instead of being hidden with
it, and its effects can be off too), some shadows
don't fall or turn like the others in the clip, and the race view sometimes shows more of the
road behind the vehicle it follows than ahead of it. Which things, when, and what they should
look like instead can be seen in the recording: the same kind of thing is drawn correctly
elsewhere in the same clip.

Please fix all problems. Apart from these, the track layout and the vehicles' movement in
the recording are correct and should keep looking the way they do now.

## Attached visual evidence

The recording is at `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4`.

Inspect the attached video before making changes. You can pull individual frames out of it with
`ffmpeg`.

arguments.command: cd /app; git ls-files | head -100; git ls-files | wc -l; ls -la .harbor_assets

steps.message:
I couldn't watch the recording: `/app/.harbor_assets/` is empty and there's no `recording.mp4` anywhere on the system. So I matched each symptom you described to the code that draws it, and fixed what I found. The code compiles and the existing `core-tests` pass, but I haven't run the game, so none of this has been checked against the clip.

**Camera shows more road behind than ahead** (`racescreen/RacerCameraUpdater.java`)
- The look-ahead offset was rotated by `90 - angle`, so its sideways part was mirrored. When the car drove mostly left or right, the camera looked behind it. It now rotates `(advance, 0)` by the car's camera angle.
- The camera speed limit was applied after the position had already been set, so it did nothing. It now runs first.
- A duplicate zoom-limit call was removed.

**Shadows that don't fall or turn like the others**
- `utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`: `drawShadow()` gave the rotation in radians where degrees were expected. Shadows of obstacles, bonus spots, mines and missiles barely turned with their object. They now rotate with it.
- `racer/VehicleRenderer.java`: vehicle shadows were offset up and to the left, while every other shadow falls down and to the right. Vehicle shadows now match.

**Carried items drawn or hidden wrongly**
- `bonus/Missile.java`: a missile still held by a car was always drawn on the top layer, so it showed through bridges and tunnels covering the car. A held missile is now drawn on the car's own layer and gets the car's sinking tint when the car falls into water. Its shadow is hidden while the car is falling, just like the car's. Its target marker stays on top. Fired missiles behave as before.
- `bonus/Mine.java`: a mine held by a falling car still showed a shadow, while the car's shadow is hidden. It no longer does. Dropped mines are unchanged.
- `racer/VehicleRenderer.java`: the turbo flame was drawn after the tint was reset, so it stayed full-color while the car sank. It now gets the same tint.

Because I couldn't see the clip, the items above are the bugs I could find from your description. It's worth checking them against the recording. If something there still looks wrong, tell me what and when (or put the file back) and I'll look again.
